title: Recorded decisions for AI-managed strategies
provenance: Hand-written for this repository so AI-managed strategies run without a model: a cycle of trade proposals priced relative to the market at the time, and decisions not to trade. No model produced them, and they say nothing about how the AI trades.

decisions.rationale: A resting buy just below the last price, with a stop 1.5% under the entry and a target 2% above it.
No clear edge at this hour, so no entry.
A smaller buy further below the market, with a tighter stop and target.
The strategy already holds entries in this market; waiting for them to exit.
